heading: CHAPTER 5. PREMIUM ADD-ON COVERS
text: [CHAPTER 5. PREMIUM ADD-ON COVERS] Add-On C: Consumables Cover Consumable items including engine oil, coolant, AC gas, nuts, bolts, and sealants replaced during an admissible partial loss repair are covered, subject to a limit of 1% of IDV or 5% of the claim amount, whichever is lower.
